# AgentPass

> AgentPass is an open preflight layer for autonomous AI actions.

Agents should call AgentPass before executing an action that spends money, moves data, or requires human approval.

## Discovery

- AgentPass manifest: https://agentpass-protocol.rmalka06.chatgpt.site/.well-known/agentpass.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://agentpass-protocol.rmalka06.chatgpt.site/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://agentpass-protocol.rmalka06.chatgpt.site/openapi.json
- MCP endpoint: https://agentpass-protocol.rmalka06.chatgpt.site/mcp
- REST endpoint: https://agentpass-protocol.rmalka06.chatgpt.site/api/preflight

## Decision semantics

- safe_to_proceed: all declared automatic checks passed.
- needs_review: a constraint or proof needs human or policy review.
- denied: a required identity or scope is missing, or a hard limit was exceeded.

The public preview returns unsigned receipts. Signed receipts, policy management, longer audit retention, and team controls are paid hosted features.
